# Tables

## [`cart_cold_start_vector`](../../src/init/cartridge_header.asm#L6) `$8000-$8003`

*addresses*

Cartridge header. At a hardware reset, the KERNAL reads the signature at $8004-$8008 and jumps through the cold start vector.
Cold start address: $8009.

<a id="freq_table"></a>
## [`freq_table`](../../src/music/freq_table.asm#L6) `$9EDD-$A05C`

*words*

SID frequencies, 192 words, low byte first. Entry 2n is the NTSC value of semitone n ($00-$5f). Each odd entry is the mean of its two neighbours, and the last entry is $ffff. Note byte n uses entry 2n. The tunes use the notes $01-$54. The driver adds the base $9edd as two immediates at $99b4 and $9d41.

- **Read by:** [`start_note`](modules/music/tick.md#start_note) [`$99BB`](../../src/music/tick.asm#L73), [`start_note`](modules/music/tick.md#start_note) [`$99C1`](../../src/music/tick.asm#L76), [`effect_pitch_step`](modules/sound/effects.md#effect_pitch_step) [`$9D4B`](../../src/sound/effects.asm#L81), [`effect_pitch_step`](modules/sound/effects.md#effect_pitch_step) [`$9D51`](../../src/sound/effects.asm#L84)

## [`tune_ptrs`](../../src/music/tunes.asm#L6) `$A193-$A276`

*addresses*

Start of each tune, 114 words (tunes $00-$71). The sound request $80+n in $dd-$df starts tune n. No request and no tune selects tunes $58, $59, $60, $65-$68 and $6f-$71. Tunes $58, $59 and $65-$68 hold only $f2.
